test_title: SSC MTS 2023 Official Paper (Held On: 04 Sept, 2023 Shift 2)
subject: general
question: 20 men can complete a piece of work in 40 days, and 40 women can do the same work in 60 days. If 10 men and 20 women work together, then in how many days will the work be completed?
solution:
**Given:**

20 men can complete a piece of work in 40 days.

40 women can do the same work in 60 days.

10 men and 20 women work together.

**Formula Used:**

Work done by 1 man in 1 day = Total work / (Number of men × Number of days)

Work done by 1 woman in 1 day = Total work / (Number of women × Number of days)

Total work done in 1 day by 10 men and 20 women = (Work done by 1 man in 1 day × 10 men) + (Work done by 1 woman in 1 day × 20 women)

Number of days to complete the work = Total work / Tota
